name: Vnc → Refresh
description: Asks the server for the whole screen again and redraws all of it. The display then refreshes in its usual mode, so on e-paper this does not always clear ghosting. On E-Paper SPI, run [`epaper_spi.full_update_next`](https://esphome.io/components/display/epaper_spi/#epaper_spi-full_update_next-action) first to make that refresh a full one.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The `vnc` client to refresh. Only needed if there is more than one.
